item.title: REMEMBERING COUNTRY JOE (January 1, 1942 - March 7, 2026)
item.description: The legendary songwriter, vocalist, guitarist and activist, COUNTRY JOE MCDONALD, has left us at the age of 82. Most well known for his anti-war and other political protest songs, Country Joe's career has found him composing and performing music spanning areas of country, folk, psychedelic rock and soul... item.title: WHFR PRESENTS THE MUSIC OF HENRY THREADGILL PART FOUR
item.description: To wrap up our four part feature of the music of HENRY THREADGILL, WHFR PRESENTS will focus on his music of the latter part of the 2010s up through the present time. In the last decade, Henry has focused a great deal upon his work as a composer and conductor. Featured works will include Henry's work with WADADA LEO SMITH'S Great Lakes Quartet and his own 14 or 15 kestra (taking off on the concept of Sun Ra's Arkestra). Finally, a return where it all started with music from AIR and the Sextet(t).

item.title: "WHFR Journal" Talks Autism Awareness AND Acceptance -- Friday, April 3, at 1pm
item.description: Join us tomorrow, April 3 as we kick off Autism Awareness Month on the WHFR Journal. We'll share a special show from the PRX series "Top of Mind", titled "Improving Life for People with Autism". Host Julie Rose speaks with advocates about awareness and, even more importantly, acceptance of people with Autism. You'll also hear about a couple of musical delights coming to HFC and the Dearborn area for you to enjoy. Tune in tomorrow at 1pm only on the WHFR Journal.
